name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (battle item-use stat-modifier helper). Descriptor accurately reflects purpose: applies a permanent stat-up modifier to a target with impact animation and consumes the item. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Applies a permanent stat-up item effect (HP/MP/AP/DP/DX/movement-up scrolls) to the first target with full impact animation, draws the boost number, recalculates the caster's derived stats, and consumes the item.
logic_summary: Single basic block, no branches. (1) Plays fd2_animate_spell_impact_per_target and fd2_animate_status_effect_overlay_flicker for the whole target set (visual coverage). (2) Reads the first target id from p_target_array and adds the signed-short stat_delta to the int16 field at field_offset inside that target's runtime_char (single-target stat write -- only target[0] is modified). (3) fd2_show_damage_number(stat_delta, 0x5E='^', target_id) shows the boost amount with the stat-boost glyph. (4) fd2_composite_battle_frame(0) + fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths() finish the frame. (5) fd2_recalculate_combat_stats(caster_idx) re-sums the caster's derived stats. (6) fd2_remove_inventory_slot_at(caster_idx, inv_slot) consumes the scroll.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_apply_item_stat_modifier_with_anim(uint32 caster_idx, uint32 stat_delta, uint32 field_offset, uint32 inv_slot, uint32 target_count, uint32 p_target_array, uint32 anim_idx)

params.semantics: Caster runtime_char index; passed to the two animation fns, to fd2_recalculate_combat_stats, and to fd2_remove_inventory_slot_at. Source declaration already names this caster_idx correctly.
params.reason: Live Ghidra signature uses generic param_1; should match the already-correct source name caster_idx (Stage 2 will align Ghidra/protos to src).

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: Signed-short stat delta to ADD to the target stat field; also passed as the value to fd2_show_damage_number. Source declaration names this stat_delta correctly.
params.reason: Live Ghidra signature uses generic param_2; should match the already-correct source name stat_delta.

params.name: param_3
params.semantics: Struct field offset within the target runtime_char selecting which stat to bump (0x37/0x39/0x3E/0x42/0x46/0x3B from the dispatcher). Source declaration names this field_offset correctly.
params.reason: Live Ghidra signature uses generic param_3; should match the already-correct source name field_offset.

params.name: consumer_idx
params.semantics: Inventory slot index of the scroll to consume after applying; passed to fd2_remove_inventory_slot_at(caster_idx, inv_slot). Source declaration names this inv_slot.
params.reason: Ghidra name consumer_idx is acceptable but the source uses inv_slot; Stage 2 should align Ghidra/protos to the source name inv_slot for consistency. No address residue, but name should match src.

params.semantics: MISNAMED in live Ghidra signature: this is target_count, passed only to the two impact-animation fns (the actual stat delta is param_2). Source declaration correctly names this target_count.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name stat_delta is wrong (it is the target count, not the delta); must align to the correct source name target_count in Stage 2.

params.semantics: MISNAMED in live Ghidra signature: this is a pointer to the target byte array (p_target_array); *p_target_array is the first target's runtime_char index (the field offset is actually param_3). Source declaration correctly names this p_target_array.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name stat_field_offset is wrong (it is the target-id array pointer, not a field offset); must align to the correct source name p_target_array in Stage 2.

params.name: inventory_slot
params.semantics: MISNAMED in live Ghidra signature: this is the animation/spell-sprite index (0x11/0x12/0x13/0x0D) passed to both impact-animation fns; the inventory slot is actually param_4. Source declaration correctly names this anim_idx.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name inventory_slot is wrong (it is the animation index, not an inventory slot); must align to the correct source name anim_idx in Stage 2.

returns.semantics: No return value; effects are the stat write, on-screen animations, derived-stat recalc, and item consumption.
